================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO NO AFTER EFFECTS - NĀ MEA HOU
Paʻi 9.2.8  -  ʻOkakopa 2026
================================================================================

Ke ʻōlelo nei ka panel i nā ʻŌLELO he 132 i kēia manawa, aia nā KUMUHANA DEMON SLAYER hou me ka
pahi kaua e ʻoki ana i nā pihi āu e kaomi ai, a me kekahi mau hoʻoponopono i ka hoʻolālā a me Windows.

MA MUA O KA HOʻOMAKA
- Hoʻokomo ma luna o kou paʻi o kēia manawa me kāu mea hoʻokomo ZXP maʻamau, a laila hoʻomaka hou iā
  After Effects i hoʻokahi manawa.
- Mālama ʻia kāu mau hoʻonohonoho, kumuhana, preset, a me nā expression i waiho ʻia.

HOU: KA PANEL ME NĀ ʻŌLELO HE 132
- Ua helu ʻia nā ʻōlelo he 132 ma Nā Hoʻonohonoho Flex > ʻŌLELO i kēia manawa, me ka pahu ʻimi. Koho i
  kekahi, a hoʻololi ka panel holoʻokoʻa: nā tab, nā pihi, nā tooltip, nā memo.
- Ua unuhi ʻia kēlā me kēia ʻōlelo e ka AI mai ka panel ʻōlelo Pelekānia mai, ʻaʻole ma ka huaʻōlelo
  ma ka huaʻōlelo. Mau nō ka ʻōlelo Pelekānia o nā inoa āu e ʻike ai i kāu papahana (nā inoa papa, nā
  inoa hopena) i kūlike mau lākou me After Effects.
- Ua unuhi ʻia nō hoʻi ka pop-up "nā mea hou", mai kēia paʻi aku.

HOU: NĀ KUMUHANA DEMON SLAYER
- Aia ma Nā Hoʻonohonoho Flex > MEA KOHO KUMUHANA kekahi pūʻulu DEMON SLAYER hou me 11 kumuhana:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen a me Kokushibo.
- E hoʻoneʻe i ka ʻiole ma luna o ka panel a hahai ka mea o ke kumuhana iā ia: wai,
  ahi, uwila, pulelehua, lau pua, noe a me nā mea ʻē aʻe. Ke kū ka ʻiole,
  nalo mālie ia.
- Kaomi i kekahi pihi a ʻoki ka pahi kaua o ia kanaka iā ia. E paʻa i ka pihi hema
  a ʻoki mau nō; e paʻa no ka 2.5 kekona a pahū ia.
- Hana ʻia e māmā mau: holo wale nā hopena ke hoʻoneʻe a kaomi paha ʻoe, a
  māmā ʻoi aku ia ma kāna iho ma nā kamepiula lohi. E hoʻopau i NĀ HOPENA AMBIENT
  ma ka Mea Koho Kumuhana i mālama wale i nā waihoʻoluʻu.

HOʻOLOLI ʻIA: NĀ PIHI PĀLAHALAHA MA NĀ KUMUHANA A PAU
- ʻAʻole hoʻohana nā pihi hana a me nā pihi nui ma nā kumuhana waihoʻoluʻu i ka hoʻololi
  waihoʻoluʻu mai luna a lalo. Hoʻokahi waihoʻoluʻu pālahalaha me ka ʻālohilohi mālie, no laila
  ʻoi aku ka maʻemaʻe a ʻoi aku ka maopopo o ka heluhelu.

HOʻOPONOPONO ʻIA
- Hiki i ke kāleka laikini a me ka pop-up "nā mea hou" ke wehe ma luna o kekahi i kekahi.
  ʻAʻole lākou e uhi hou i kekahi i kekahi, a ʻaʻole e uhi hou ka hōʻailona HŌʻANO HOU i
  nā pihi ma luna o ka panel.
- Ma NUI UI 125% a me 150%, hiki i kekahi mau puka aniani (e like me Nā Hoʻonohonoho Flex)
  ke ulu ʻoi aku ke kiʻekiʻe ma mua o ka panel, a nalo ka pihi pani mai ka maka. Kūpono kēlā
  me kēia puka aniani i kēlā me kēia nui.
- Windows: Hiki i AutoCaptions ke ʻōlelo "KAHIKO LOA KA NVIDIA DRIVER NO NĀ CAPTION GPU"
  ma nā kāleka a me nā driver hou (RTX 40 a me 50 series). Heluhelu pololei ia i
  ka kākoʻo CUDA o ka driver a hoʻohana i kāu GPU.

HOʻOLOLI ʻOLE ʻIA
- Hana like nō ka laikini, ka hoʻāla ʻana, a me nā loulou a pau e like me mua.
- Like nō me ka paʻi 9.2.7 ka hana ʻana o kēlā me kēia tab a me ka mea hana ʻē aʻe.
================================================================================

FLEX ULTIMATE NO PREMIERE PRO - NĀ MEA HOU
Paʻi 2.2.8  -  ʻOkakopa 2026

Ua lilo nā caption CAPTION STACK i mau template Motion Graphics HIKI KE HOʻOPONOPONO ʻIA me kekahi
mea hoʻoponopono maoli, aia ka AUDIO STUDIO hou a me MARK AUDIO BEATS, ke ʻōlelo nei ka panel i nā
ʻŌLELO he 132, hōʻea mai ka NUI UI i ULTIMATE, a aia nā KUMUHANA DEMON SLAYER hou.

MA MUA O KA HOʻOMAKA
- Hoʻokomo ma luna o kou paʻi o kēia manawa me kāu mea hoʻokomo ZXP maʻamau, a laila hoʻomaka hou iā
  Premiere Pro i hoʻokahi manawa.
- Mālama ʻia kāu mau hoʻonohonoho, kumuhana, a me nā preset.

HOU: CAPTION STACK - NĀ CAPTION HIKI KE HOʻOPONOPONO ʻIA (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Waiho ʻia nā caption i mau template Motion Graphics hiki ke hoʻoponopono ʻia (Puka >
  MOGRT HIKI KE HOʻOPONOPONO ʻIA, ke koho paʻamau hou ma Premiere Pro 2026). Ma hope o ka waiho ʻana,
  hiki iā ʻoe ke hoʻololi i kēlā me kēia huaʻōlelo, font, waihoʻoluʻu, nui, kūlana, glow, outline, pahu,
  animation, a i ʻole ka manawa ma ka panel Essential Graphics o Premiere.
- Puka > NĀ KIʻI e waiho mau nō i kēlā me kēia huaʻōlelo i kiʻi me ke ʻano pololei,
  inā makemake ʻoe i kēlā.
- Hele pū mai nā template me ka panel. ʻAʻohe mea e hoʻoiho ai.

HOU: MEA HOʻOPONOPONO CAPTION STACK
- Hōʻike ka nānā mua i ke kiʻi maoli o kāu wikiō ma lalo o kēlā me kēia caption.
- E huki i ke caption e hoʻoneʻe iā ia, e hoʻohana i ke kihi e hoʻololi i ka nui a me ka kiko ma luna
  e kaʻapuni ai, kaomi pālua i ka huaʻōlelo e hoʻoponopono. Hoʻoneʻe ka CAPTION HOLOʻOKOʻA i nā
  huaʻōlelo a pau, hoʻoneʻe ka HUAʻŌLELO HOʻOKAHI i hoʻokahi huaʻōlelo.
- E koho inā pili ka hoʻololi i nā caption a pau a i ʻole kēia caption wale nō, a mālama
  i kāu mau hoʻolālā e hoʻohana hou ai.
- 10 ʻano GLOW hou: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow a me Superb.

HOU: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- E koho i kahi clip leo, e koho i kahi hopena a kaomi i HOʻOHANA. Holo nā mea a pau ma
  kāu kamepiula.
- 30 preset hoʻokahi kaomi: Underwater, Bass Boost, Room / Hall / Cathedral /
  Plate reverb, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse a me nā mea hou aku. E hoʻopaʻa i nā
  hopena he nui loa āu e makemake ai, e hoʻonohonoho hou iā lākou, a e hoʻopau i kekahi.
- Mālama ka Reverb i kona huelo: hoʻokani ka leo ma hope o ka pau ʻana o ke clip, a waiho ʻia
  i ʻaʻole e kākau ʻia kekahi mea ma kāu timeline.
- Nā mea hana: Noise Remover, Voice Enhance, Loudness (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Hum Remover, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Speed
  a me Pitch, Noise Gate, Extract Audio.
- Ke māhele nei ka STEMS MAKER i ke mele i nā leo mele a me ke mele (a i ʻole 4 stem). Hoʻoiho ia
  i kāna model i ka manawa mua a nīnau mua iā ʻoe.
- Hiki iā ʻoe ke lohe i kahi o 8 kekona ma NĀNĀ MUA me ka hoʻololi Original / Processed.
  Waiho ʻia ka hopena ma kahi ala leo wehe a hoʻopau ʻia ka leo o kāu clip kumu,
  ʻaʻole hoʻopau loa ʻia.

HOU: MARK AUDIO BEATS (FX & ADV RIGS > MARK AUDIO BEATS)
- E koho i kahi clip mele ma ka timeline a kaomi i HŌʻAILONA I NĀ BEAT: ʻike ʻo Flex i nā
  beat a hoʻohui i nā hōʻailona sequence ma luna iho, no laila pili pololei kāu mau ʻoki i ke
  mele.
- E koho i nā hit A PAU, nā KICK, a i ʻole nā SNARE, e hoʻonohonoho i ka sensitivity, a e hōʻailona i kēlā me kēia beat a i ʻole
  kēlā me kēia beat 2 a i ʻole 4.
- Ma ka WEHE I NĀ HŌʻAILONA BEAT, wehe ʻia nā hōʻailona i hoʻohui ʻia e Flex wale nō. Holo ma
  kāu kamepiula.

HOU: KA PANEL ME NĀ ʻŌLELO HE 132
- Ua helu ʻia nā ʻōlelo he 132 ma Nā Hoʻonohonoho > ʻŌLELO i kēia manawa, me ka pahu ʻimi. Hoʻololi nā
  tab, nā pihi, nā tooltip a me nā memo a pau. Ua unuhi ʻia ka pop-up "nā mea hou"
  i kēia paʻi aku.

HOU: NUI UI
- Ma Nā Hoʻonohonoho > NUI UI hiki ke hoʻonui a hōʻemi i ka panel holoʻokoʻa, e like me
